notes.title: Patch Notes for Wukong's Journey DLC Release
notes.notes:
Hello Generals! We hope you're having a blast with the new Wukong's Journey DLC! 

We're thrilled to see the very positive reviews (over 80%, wow!). Thanks for all the feedback, keep it coming! Now, while Wukong’s been stealing the spotlight, we’ve also been busy squashing bugs, tweaking towers, and teaching Sylvara how to hit flying things (took her a while). 

[b]Here’s the full list of changes:[/b][list]

[*] Added the Encyclopedia
[*] Favorite Customer Upgrade now works as a discount instead of a refund.
[*] Fixed a bug where modifiers wouldn't apply to Boneheart, Kosmyr or Broden.
[*] Eldritch Channeler: Fixed a bug where it would stay in its attack stance despite losing its target.
[*] Twilight Longbows: Improved bullets’ accuracy so it doesn't miss as much.
[*] Dwarven Flamespitter: Improved flamethrower's accuracy. It now recalculates enemy position at the end of the firing animation, instead of at the beginning. 
[*] Bog Hermit: Improved magic bullets’ accuracy so it doesn't miss as much.
[*] Necromancer: Adjusted attack mechanic so it doesn't spend all its saved charges when not needed.
[*] Grim Wraiths: Added a level up animation
[*] Kratoa: Is now immune to the Flaming Ground Mechanic.
[*] Kosmyr: Fixed a bug where his passive wouldn't do any extra damage
[*] Sylvara: Can now target flying enemies. Fixed the "blindspots” she had while attacking
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3732970/Kingdom_Rush_5_Alliance_TD__Wukongs_Journey_Campaign/

notes.title: Balance Patch: Buffs to Towers, Heroes, and Enemies
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/42cd51c27270295e13036f570743a30968692584.png[/img]
Hello Generals! As promised, we are making a big set of balance changes to Kingdom Rush Alliance. 
You’ll notice we’ve buffed up the weaker towers and heroes, while some Colossal Dwarfare enemies have been strengthened mostly on Impossible difficulty.

[h3][b]Full changelog:[/b][/h3]

[h3]Towers[/h3] [list]

[*] [b]Dwarven Flamespitter: [/b]Can now target flying enemies

[*] [b]Brewmasters: [/b]Halfdan attack speed buffed 1.5 sec -> 1 sec

[*] [b]Necromancer:[/b] Basic skeleton now has 50 HP (from 40) and 3-5 damage (from 1-4). Golem has 150 HP (from 120) and 8-12 dmg (from 6-10). Cooldown for Rattling Beacon was reduced in levels 1 and 2

[*] [b]Elven Stargazer: [/b]fixed attack rate change bug between some upgrades, Reload Damage increased from 4-6/10-16/20-28/32-48 to 4-6/11-18/22-32/34-52 Event Horizon Cost decreased from 250/150/150 to 250/100/100 Rising Star Damage increased from 16-24/28-42/36-54 to 18-30/28-42/36-54 Rising Star Range increased from 120 to 200 Rising Star Stun increased from 0.5 to 0.8

[*] [b]Twilight Longbows: [/b]Basic Attack Damage increased from 14-18/35-48/66-90/106-142 to 14-22/40-54/76-92/134-146 Range including from 200/220/250/280 to 200/230/260/300 Support Blades Damage changed from 10-14/14-22/24-37 to 12-16/16-24/22-34 Support Blades Dodge chance increased from 40% to 60%.

[*] [b]Cannoneer Squad:[/b] Base Cost reduced from 80/130/200/260 to 60/130/180/240 Respawn timer reduced from 10 seconds to 8 Seconds Growing Ranks cost reduced from 150/200/250 to 120/180/240 Incendiary Ammo Bomb Damage increased from 20-28/34-50/48-72 to 20-28/38-58/52-80 Incendiary Ammo Burn Damage increased from 3/7/12 to 3/8/14[/list]

[h3]Heroes[/h3] [list]

[*] [b]Torres:[/b] Men at Work HP: 50/75/100 -> 75/100/125 Defensive Turret: cooldown - 30/30/30 -> 25/25/25, damage - 6-10/14-22/22-34 -> 8-12/16-24/24-36

[*] [b]Stregi:[/b] Speed: 120 -> 180 Health: 240 -> 265 Damage: 13-19 -> 15-22 Night Furies: cooldown - 20/20/20 -> 18/18/18, number of cats - 1/2/3 -> 2/3/4 Pumpkling speed: 24 -> 20 Dazzling Decoy: distance - 130 -> 160, cooldown - 20/20/20 -> 18/18/18, decoy health - 30/50/70 -> 50/75/100, decoy damage - 8-12/10-14/13-18 -> 8-12/12-18/16-24, stun duration - 1s/2s/3s -> 2s/2.5s/3s [/list]

[h3]Enemies[/h3] [list]

[*] [b]Darksteel Hammerer:[/b] HP increased from 400 to 420 on Veteran Difficulty (450 for Impossible).

[*] [b]Rolling Sentry: [/b]Reduced HP to 450/520/640/720 and increased damage from 6-10 to 10-18

[*][b] Brute Welder: [/b]Tower stun from 8 to 10 seconds (Impossible only)

[*] [b]Darksteel Fist: [/b]Slam skill cooldown reduced from 4 to 3 seconds ((Impossible only)

[*] [b]Mad Tinkerer:[/b] Increased Magic Res from 60% to 80% (Impossible only)

[*] [b]Darksteel Anvil:[/b] Increased Magic Res to 50% and reduced skill cooldown from 10 to 8 (both Impossible only)

[*] [b]Machinist Grymbeard:[/b] Increased scrap bomb damage from 108-72 to 145-95. Increased fire blast damage from 4 fps to 16-24 dps. Burning debuff increased damage from 4 dps to 4-12 dps and duration from 2 to 4 seconds.

[*] [b]Darksteel Hulk:[/b] Reduced “safe nodes” and HP threshold for the charge to be triggered. 
[/list]

Give the changes a try and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Colossal Dwarfare Balance Changes
notes.notes:
Hello Generals!

We've been closely listening to your feedback on the Colossal Dwarfare update, and today we're rolling out some balance adjustments. These changes are just the beginning, and we’ll continue to monitor feedback and make adjustments as needed.

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Enemies
[/b]Flying Sentry: HP down from 250 to 200
Scrap Drone: HP down from 100 to 50
Darksteel Hammerer: HP down from 450 to 400
Darksteel Shielder now gives 30 gold
Darksteel Guardian now gives 250 gold and deals less damage (when not "Frenzied")
DarksteelHulk: Fixed speed-up bug. Now it won't trigger it's run near exits
Stage 23: Adjusted some timings and quantity of enemies' to reduce some of the pressure at certain points

[b]Others[/b]
Tweaks to Kratoa's power curve so he'll be stronger from the get-go at level 5  
Toned down some loud SFXs

[h3]What's next?[/h3]

We’ll keep listening and tweaking where needed, always with the goal of keeping the challenge engaging. If you have thoughts please fill out our [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfy-pUEhA4JQffi-M8hgfNPtt841gNkxxu6AFRDBRXePP0DOA/viewform?usp=header]feedback form![/url]

notes.title: Abominor Mechanics Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971628/b994b6107fff322d15fbcf7007ee422f86a339e7.jpg[/img]

We’ve heard your feedback loud and clear, and we’re excited to share some changes we made to Abominor. Many of you raised concerns about its tower-destroying mechanic, and we’ve reworked it to make the encounter more balanced and rewarding.

[h3]What's New?[/h3]

Abominor will no longer outright destroy towers. Instead, towers will now be reduced to rubble. You’ll have the option to repair these ruins, restoring your tower back to action—for a cost. This change keeps the tension high without feeling overly punishing. Additionally, Abominor’s stats have been adjusted to ensure a fair but challenging experience.


[h3]Abominor's adjustments:[/h3]

[b]Speed (across phases):[/b]
[list][*] Old: 22/19/14/10/7
[*] New: 24/21/17/14/12[/list]
[b]Restore HP on Phase Up:[/b]
[list][*] Old: 1700/2200/1700/2200
[*] New: 1700/2200/1700/4000[/list]
[b]Tower Eating Cooldown:[/b]
[list][*] Old: 12/12/18/18/20
[*] New: 12/12/16/16/18[/list]

Thank you for your feedback and for helping us improve the game with every update.
Try it out and let us know what you think!
